rule: docs/slices/locale-1.md § 16.2 item 5 (coverage rule), for CDL-1 (docs/slices/catalog-data-labels-1.md § 3.1; record docs/slices/cdl-1.md): the nine catalog keys this slice adds are SERVER texts — the backend writes them into products at a glam import (import*) or mails them to the site owner (interestMail*); no renderer reads them. Each maps to the checks at its reader: backend/test/unit/glam-import-handler.test.ts (the handler writes the resolved site labels and the default option name), backend/test/unit/interest-integration.test.ts (the whole mail, RO equal to today's literal mail, EN the ruled texts), packages/shared/test/cdl-1.test.ts (catalogServerTexts: pack values and the non-empty rule). No key is a count key. Checked by renderer/test/unit/locale-coverage.test.ts.

catalog.importCollectionAttribute.case: labels absent → the site labels (English site): written, recorded as importLabels, and reported with used = site
ro-RO without overrides → today's Romanian words

catalog.importUnitAttribute.case: labels absent → the site labels (English site): written, recorded as importLabels, and reported with used = site
ro-RO without overrides → today's Romanian words

catalog.importVariantName.case: request option name absent or blank → the site default under labels = site AND labels = file
ro-RO without overrides → today's Romanian words
